items.rationale: External rainwater flooding falls under group (c2), which is not shown as insured. Clause 3.6.2(b) bars the labour; €1,140 is the conditional gross estimate at €95 per hour.
Clause 3.6.2(f) bars all journey charges for the uninsured flood. If the flood were covered, this first journey would be eligible under 7.1.7(g), estimated at €60 gross.

Clause 3.6.2(d) bars pumping costs for the uninsured flood. Even on a covered claim, 5.2.2 would not pay separately for procuring equipment used in the billed extraction; €1 is a required positive placeholder.
Clause 3.6.2(d) bars this cost, and 5.2.2 independently treats the pump as included in the separately billed extraction measure. The €1 amount is a required positive placeholder.

Clauses 3.6.2(d) and 5.1 bar extraction costs for the uninsured flood, even though pumping was necessary. The conditional gross estimate is €420 for one extraction operation, including labour and equipment.
Clause 3.6.2(c) bars materials used to repair uninsured flood damage. If covered, 7.1.7(c) would allow equivalent materials actually installed, estimated at €145 gross.

items.description: Boiler, flue and storage tank replacement
items.rationale: Fixed heating plant is insured property under 4.2.2, but 3.6.2(a) bars replacement after this uninsured flood. Under 7.1.1(c), a like-for-like installed system would be about €10,500 gross, excluding separately billed pipe adaptation and disposal.

Clause 3.6.2(a) expressly bars adaptation work associated with replacement after an uninsured flood. The conditional €620 gross estimate covers only the connections needed to fit the replacement boiler under 7.1.7(d).
Clauses 3.6.2(e) and 5.1 bar disposal costs arising from the uninsured flood. The conditional €280 gross estimate covers ordinary removal, hauling and disposal of the old system.
Clause 3.6.2(f) bars this journey charge; even with flood cover, 7.1.8(d) excludes the second journey charge for the same event. The €1 amount is a required positive placeholder.
